objections.claim: Unrestricted server-side fetching of user URLs exposes server-accessible resources to the caller through SSRF.
objections.evidence: HOW explicitly requires fetch(userUrl) without an allow-list and streams the response body to the caller.
objections.predicted_consequence: A caller can submit a loopback or private-network URL and receive the body of a service reachable from the backend, exposing internal data.
